title: Clean version label & URL hygiene
summary: The top-bar build chip always shows the real RestroSuite version (e.g. v151). Legacy ?appv=Systempatch URLs are rewritten automatically, and updates never write marketing labels into the address bar.
highlights: Address bar auto-cleans ?appv=Systempatch to the real short build tag without a hard reload.
Version chip shows v151 with a live indicator; click copies the full build id.
Save & Update only writes clean tags like v151 — never Systempatch.
WhatsApp reconnect, notification panel, and top-bar click fixes from v147–v149 remain included.
